props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the keycap, rendered as `aria-label`. Overrides the spoken name of a key alias; plain keys have no `aria-label` unless set.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Whether to resolve known key aliases to symbols.

props.name: translations
props.description: Localized spoken names for key aliases, keyed by alias such as `meta` or `escape`. Used as the `aria-label` when `value` is an alias and `ariaLabel` is not set.

props.name: value
props.description:
The key to display. A name matching a built-in alias, compared case-insensitively
(`meta`, `ctrl`, `shift`, `escape`, `arrowup`, ...), shows its symbol or short label, such as `⌘` for
`meta` or `Esc` for `escape`, unless `symbol` is `false`. Any other string renders as written, such as `K` or `F5`.
Nothing renders for an empty string.
